column1: # Key of the cipher sheet BnF fr. 4700 f. 80r (Vincenzo Badalocchio, Rome, January 1593).
# The letters are the key that we rebuilt from the Duke's minute of 1 May 1593 (folder nevers-1593), unchanged.
# The other values are added from this sheet. No key sheet of this cipher is known to us.
# value: a raised dot = a null (no meaning); ? = no value.
# count = how many times the group stands in groups.txt (decode.py counts them again).
# state: minute = a value of the minute; sure = fixed by the sense of one clear place or more;
#        probable = one place, or the sense is not complete; open = no value.
# words = the words that fix the value. CAPITALS mark the place of the group in the word. u and v are one letter.
#         A raised dot in a word is a null. Square brackets hold letters that the sheet does not have.
